author: raymond91125
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete
GO:0015695 organic cation transport replaced_by GO:0055085 transmembrane transport
GO:0015711 organic anion transport replaced_by GO:0055085 transmembrane transport
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/30715

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1kpx8vdhKGebcQb4pgDFUo3Gdww0Qfs-T29liYMhn9PI

Impacted groups: 
ARUK-UCL	15 - done
MGI	9
PINC	6
RGD	15
UniProt	25
FlyBase	4
ZFIN	1

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule) 
term	file	line
GO:0015711	interpro2go	InterPro:IPR004679 2-hydroxycarboxylate transporter > GO:organic anion transport ; GO:0015711
GO:0015711	interpro2go	InterPro:IPR046329 Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 4A1-like > GO:organic anion transport ; GO:0015711


Thanks.
title: Review annotations to organic anion/cation transport

author: RLovering
body:
Hi
URGENT: The term ‘transport’ is not to be used for direct annotation. Please update this ticket with a suggestion for a alternative term that we can apply.

DO NOT obsolete these terms until we have had a chance to update these annotations with an appropriate term. 

Many Thanks
Ruth

author: hattrill
body:
Looks like all the EXP annotations are for Solute Carriers or ABC transporters 
so GO:0055085 transmembrane transport 
and also for the InterPro mappings

author: raymond91125
body:
